copy.page_title: Swap your old Mika | GreenBay x Mika
copy.description: Trade in your old Mika appliance for Mika credit. GreenBay values it, checks it and buys it. You spend the credit on something new from Mika.
copy.headline_1: Your old Mika still has value.
copy.headline_2: Put it towards a new one.
copy.lede: Tell us about your old Mika appliance and we will make you a fair offer, paid as Mika credit. GreenBay checks the item and buys it from you. You spend the credit on anything new from Mika.
copy.run_by: Valued and bought by GreenBay Second Life Appliances
copy.card_note: Example only. Your offer depends on your appliance.

steps.title: Tell us about it
steps.body: Four short steps: what it is, how old it is, its condition, and a few photos. It takes about two minutes.

steps.title: See your offer
steps.body: We value it against real resale prices and show you a figure in Mika credit. Every Mika appliance we accept is worth at least KES 500.

steps.title: We check it
steps.body: Our team calls you to arrange a check. For fridges and washing machines a GreenBay technician comes to you. Smaller items can be dropped at a GreenBay shop.

steps.title: Spend it at Mika
steps.body: Once the check is done, your credit is ready. Use it at Mika within 90 days and pay the difference on your new appliance.

credit_rows: Mika credit equal to your accepted offer, and never less than KES 500.
With Mika only, on new Mika appliances.

90 days from the day it is issued.
Use it across more than one purchase until it runs out.
The credit is not paid out as cash.
GreenBay values, checks and buys your old appliance. Mika sells and delivers the new one.
copy.accepts: Old Mika fridges and freezers, cookers and ovens, microwaves, washing machines and small kitchen appliances. Working or not.
copy.eval_sub: Four short steps. Kay, our evaluator, keeps you company as you go.
faq: Does it have to be a Mika?
Yes. This swap is for Mika appliances. For other brands, GreenBay can still make you a cash offer at evaluate.greenbay.market.
What if it is very old or not working?
Send it in anyway. Every Mika appliance we accept is worth at least KES 500 in credit. What we cannot resell is stripped for parts or recycled.
What if the check finds something different?
Our team talks it through with you before anything is final. No credit is issued until you agree.
How do I get my credit?
Once your item has been checked, our customer team calls you with your Mika credit code.
copy.footer_legal: GreenBay Second Life Appliances values, inspects and buys your old appliance. New Mika products are sold and delivered by Mika (Ideal Appliances Ltd). The Mika name and logo belong to their owner.
